name: knowledge
description: Live shared knowledge (docs + Claude memory) through a knowledge server

url.title: Knowledge server URL
url.description: Base URL of the knowledge server, without /mcp

token.title: Device token
token.description: Leave empty when the token is in the keyring (Linux: secret-tool store --label="Knowledge server token" service knowledge; Windows: cmdkey /generic:knowledge /user:knowledge /pass). Otherwise the token for this device from the admin page /ui/admin
